info.title: LearnHouse
info.description: LearnHouse is an open-source platform tailored for learning experiences.

post.description: Issue a JWT access token on behalf of a user. The user must belong to the organization matching the org_slug. Requires `users.action_update` permission. Privileged targets (org Admin/Maintainer, platform backoffice staff member) are refused.

200.description: Access token minted on behalf of the target user.

401.description: No credentials, or an invalid, expired or revoked API token

403.description: API token lacks permission, target is privileged, user not in org, or org_slug mismatch

post.description: Mint a short-lived session for a learner, for the LearnHouse embed components (@learnhouse/react, @learnhouse/vue) to act as that learner in a browser. The session lasts 15 minutes by default (1 hour at most) and has no refresh token: mint a new one when it expires. It only works inside this organization, only on the routes the embed components use, and never on account settings. Requires `users.action_update` permission. Privileged targets (org Admin/Maintainer, platform backoffice staff member) and accounts that belong to other organizations are refused.

200.description: Embed session minted for the learner.

401.description: No credentials, or an invalid, expired or revoked API token

403.description: API token lacks permission, target is privileged or shared, user not in org, or org_slug mismatch

post.description:
Generate a short-lived URL that, when opened in a browser, will log the target user in and optionally redirect them to a specific path. Token lifetime is clamped to 60–900 seconds.

The URL is on the organization's own site (its verified custom domain, else its LearnHouse subdomain). Each link signs in once: any later use is refused. A user with two-factor authentication enabled is still asked for their code.

The target must be an ordinary member. Consuming the link mints a full session, so the same rule as `/users/{user_id}/token` applies: an API token cannot sign in as an organization Admin or Maintainer, or as a platform backoffice staff member. Requires `users.action_update` permission.

200.description: Magic sign-in URL and underlying JWT. Token lifetime is already clamped.

400.description: redirect_to is not a same-origin path, or host is not a verified custom domain of the organization

401.description: No credentials, or an invalid, expired or revoked API token

403.description: User not in this org, or the target is an Admin, Maintainer or backoffice; distinguish by the detail message before treating it as a membership problem

OrgMemberUserRead.title: OrgMemberUserRead
OrgMemberUserRead.description:
A member as seen by an org admin (members list, admin-token user reads).

SECURITY: ``User`` is a global account shared across every org it joins.
``extra_metadata`` collects signup-field answers from *all* of those orgs,
and ``is_backoffice_staff`` is platform-level. An org admin must see neither, so
this view drops ``is_backoffice_staff`` and the caller filters ``extra_metadata``
down to the keys of the viewing org's own declared signup fields (see
``for_org``). ``signup_method``/``last_login_at`` stay: the members table
renders them.
